thesis: 10/10 short on silver following the metals regime: trend 2 and relative strength 2 confirm the down leg, regime 2/2 is backed by a fresh 52-wk-high DXY (103.64) and a ~5.12% 10-year yield crushing high real-yield-sensitive precious metals.
invalidation: SLV closes above the stop-adjacent 46.23 on a broad risk-off metals bid, or DXY rolls below 102.00 removing the dollar anchor of the regime.
dissent: Fails if silver's industrial-metal demand narrative (AI/data-center power, electrification) plus a geopolitical safe-haven spike push SLV above 46.23 despite the high-real-yield regime.
